D-03 (5a34dc6): The BSGS rotation-key set is sized by the sample count (1280 -> 89 keys) but the only EvalRotate site spans the feature count: the trace shows used indices -1..-4. Sizing the key set for 16 yields 6 keys (-1,-2,-3,-4,-8,-12) that still cover every used index (second reviewer's evidence). Patch: transformations/sol_lin_reg.rotation_keys.by_samples_to_by_features.diff. Correctness metric: abs(final encrypted MSE - final plaintext MSE), from the program's own epoch-4 log lines. Traced: keys.unused_in_observed_run.v1 positive before, positive after. The rule still fires after the patch because the 6-key set keeps two unused indices (-8, -12) that the BSGS layout for 16 always generates; the patch removes 83 of the 85 unused keys.

D-03 (5a34dc6): CipherScope observed 6 levels consumed per epoch (each epoch re-encrypts the weights) against 12 configured. Depth 6 is refused by OpenFHE (FLEXIBLEAUTO defers the last rescale, so one more level than the observed consumption is needed); depth 7 is the smallest that runs. Patch: transformations/sol_lin_reg.mult_depth.12_to_7.diff. Correctness metric: abs(final encrypted MSE - final plaintext MSE), from the program's own epoch-4 log lines. Traced: parameters.depth_headroom_observed.v1 positive before, clean after.

D-03 (5a34dc6): config.yml carries '# TODO: swap out the values below' with HEStd_128_classic and ring 131072 commented beside HEStd_NotSet and 32768. At depth 33 with 59-bit scaling primes the modulus exceeds the 128-bit bound for 32768 (and 65536), so the patch takes both commented values; the timing columns are the cost of enforcing the standard. Patch: transformations/sol_log_reg.security_level.not_set_to_128_classic.diff. Correctness metric: abs difference of the final logged training loss vs the unpatched run (both arms 4 epochs). Both arms run at 4 of the program's 100 epochs (scale edit, not part of the patch); OMP_NUM_THREADS=16. Medians of 2 before / 2 after untraced runs. Traced: configuration.testing_only_security.v1 positive before, clean after. RESULT: the patched program runs and the rule clears, but its output changes beyond run-to-run spread: in a separate probe (same 4 epochs, OMP_NUM_THREADS=16) the logged loss after epoch 3 was 0.6541 unpatched and 0.5743 with HEStd_128_classic + ring 131072 (batch_size left at 16384), i.e. training follows a different trajectory, not noise. The config's TODO couples batch_size to ring/2, so the two commented values are not an isolated security switch; which trajectory matches plaintext training was not determined. Status fix_changes_result: enforcing the standard costs ~3.6-4x wall time and ~4x peak RSS here and is not a drop-in change.
